names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 3 Μαΐου, «Άγιος Θεοφάνης Μητροπολίτης Περιθεωρίου», with the rank word and the see left off.

death.note: saint.gr: «ο βίος που έγραψε κυκλοφόρησε πιθανόν μετά το 1365 μ.Χ., όπου ορίζεται ως έτος της κοιμήσεως του οσίου Μαξίμου. Ο Άγιος Θεοφάνης τότε εκοιμήθη στα τέλη του 14ου αιώνος μ.Χ.» The page gives no year; it names 1350 as the date at which he is recorded as bishop of Peritheorion, and 1365 as the year of Maximos's death, after which his life of him circulated.

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 3 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. He is closely placed: abbot of Vatopedi, disciple and biographer of Maximos Kausokalyvites, recorded as bishop of Peritheorion of Xanthi about 1350, dead at the end of the fourteenth century. **It records his canonisation by document and date**, which is unusual and is what makes the folder safe against the corpus's nine other Theophanes: «διά της υπ' αρ. 3401 της 11.4.2000 Πράξεως του Οικουμενικού Πατριαρχείου έγινε η αγιοκατάταξη του αγίου Θεοφάνη και διά της Εγκυκλίου 2692 της 18.5.2000 της Ιεράς Συνόδου της Εκκλησίας της Ελλάδος έγινε γνωστή η ένταξή του στο Αγιολόγιο», at the instance of the metropolitan Panteleimon of Xanthi and Peritheorion and of the monastery of Vatopedi, with icons painted and a service composed recently. **`types` includes `hymnographer` only because the page credits him with the life of Maximos that became the source for all his later biographers and hymnographers**, and calls his biography «ωραία»; it is the writer the page attests, and if that reads as too strong a slug the row should be read again. **Maximos Kausokalyvites, whose 13 Ιανουαρίου the page gives, has no folder in the corpus**, so there is no `related` row for the one man this life is about. No hymn is printed and no relic named.
